messages:
Anya: quick heads-up — after the kernel selector tweak rolled out at 09:12 we see a token-level latency regression on /v1/chat (~12% increase median, bigger tail).
Sam: saw the perf-bot alert. any profiling artifacts? flamegraphs? p99 token delta?
Anya: attaching short excerpt from `profiler run` (pasted):
```
kernel_select() -> chosen: fp16-emt-fallback
KV cache miss path shows +6ms/token
attention kernel dispatch time up ~15% for seq_len > 512
```
Jeff: rough hypothesis: fallback path chosen more often for longer contexts; kernel-ranking cost + dispatch overhead.
Maria: dashboard: token-level breakdown currently only has median + p95. we should add histograms per-route and per-kv-hit/miss. will add a token-latency histogram panel for /v1/chat.
perf-bot: alert: latency burn-rate for /v1/chat crossed 1.4x for 5m window at 09:17 :warning:
Sam: I can run an A/B canary disabling kernel selector heuristics for 5% of traffic and compare token-level traces. starting canary now.
deploy-bot: canary started (canary id: c-20260318-01) — routing 5% of /v1/chat.
Jeff: also saw higher batch-splitting counts in logs: batch heuristics are slicing batches more often when kernel selector returns mixed capability set => more small micro-batches.
Anya: that explains cost + latency regression. if batch-split increase, per-token overhead grows.
Maria: plan: (1) add per-route KPI: batch_size_distribution, token_latency_histogram, kv_cache_hit_rate; (2) add anomaly detector on token_tail (adaptive threshold); (3) increase paging threshold to 95th percentile at 120ms for page on-call.
Sam: for immediate mitigation I'll pin kernel selector to prefer unified kernel for seq_len > 512 in the canary group. if numbers improve, we rollback selector tweak.
Jeff: also suggest instrumenting kernel selection decisions as a tag on traces: `kernel=fp16-emt|unified|fallback` so dashboards can split by decision.
Anya: agree. small PR: add `trace.add_tag("kernel", selected_kernel)` and expose in metrics exporter.
perf-bot: info: new metric proposal posted at /infra/metrics/proposals/1760864521
Maria: I'll update alerting rules:
- burn-rate alert for route /v1/chat -> warn at 1.5x (5m), page at 2.0x (3m)
- anomaly detector on token tail (auto ML) -> warn only (so SRE can validate)
- paging threshold doc: ops runbook -> set initial page to on-call if p95 > 220ms and burn-rate > 1.8x
Sam: running canary for 20m, collecting token-level histograms and kernel tags. tagging this thread with results shortly.
Anya: thanks — if canary improves p95 by >10% we can revert selector change and iterate on kernel heuristics. otherwise we need to optimize fallback kernel dispatch code.
Jeff: I'll start a quick profile focused on dispatch overhead and batching codepaths and paste results here.
Maria: added dashboard panels and draft alert rules, pushing to staging now. will link when available.
Sam: canary ended. preliminary: canary group p95 down 9%, median unchanged. kernel-tag split shows fallback made up 38% of tokens on default group vs 4% on canary.
Anya: that matches. plan: revert selector tweak for now, open follow-up to improve fallback performance + batching heuristics. thanks everyone.
Jeff: filed perf ticket PERF-872, including flamegraphs and batch-split stats.
Maria: ops: updated runbook and alert thresholds; will monitor during next 6h. :thumbsup:
